text:
Alex Kim: Quick heads-up — Priya and I just confirmed dates and there9s a 3-week overlap where we9ll both need parental leave (June 8 - June 28). We want to coordinate so the team9s oncall and deliverables don9t take a hit.

Priya Nair: Yep — due to scheduled surgery for our baby we9ll both be out. I9m planning 8 weeks total, Alex is taking 6. Can we sketch a handoff and short-term coverage?

Jordan Liu: Thanks for the heads-up — big congrats to both. Two questions: 1) exact paid leave top-up/payroll handling? 2) oncall coverage plan during overlap?

Michelle (People Ops): Congrats! :tada: For payroll/top-up: Redwood allows concurrent leaves for teammates; each person9s leave is processed independently. Eligible top-up depends on tenure and whether you elect supplemental leave pay. Please DM me your preferred election or we can do a quick call. Also note benefits enrollment deadlines remain the same.

Sam (People Ops): Quick note on paperwork: 1) Submit leave request in the HR portal (choose "Parental leave - medical") 2) Attach the physician note for the baby9s procedure 3) Indicate exact start/end dates. We need that by May 10 to ensure payroll changes in June.

Alex Kim: @Michelle what about FMLA coordination? I9m US-based, Priya9s contractor status is different (she9s an employee but on a visa). Any special steps?

Michelle (People Ops): FMLA: we can run FMLA for each of you separately. Visa-linked benefits: Priya, we9ll run a quick check with payroll to make sure leave and payroll deductions (health insurance) stay active during the period. @Sam will follow up on visa-related bits and international tax withholding if relevant.

Sam (People Ops): I9ll check Priya9s K1/payroll profile today and confirm. If any paperwork is needed from immigration counsel we9ll flag it.

Jordan Liu: OK on coverage — my proposal: keep critical deliverables frozen week of overlap, spin up one 6-week contractor to cover triage + oncall, and rotate two ICs for async work. Can we get budget approval?

Alex Kim: Budget's the question. Do we have a policy for temporary contractor funding for parental overlap?

Michelle (People Ops): We do have a small emergency backfill pool that can be used for overlapping parental leaves. Submit a short funding request form (link in Handbook > Leaves > Backfill funding). Approvals usually within 3 business days. If you paste a one-paragraph justification here I can pre-approve it for the manager review step.

Priya Nair: Pasting draft justification: "We have two engineers on the same team (Alex Kim and Priya Nair) with overlapping parental leave (June 8-28). We request a 6-week contract backend engineer to cover oncall and critical bug triage to keep SLAs and oncall latency unaffected. Estimated cost: $15k."

Jordan Liu: LGTM. If People Ops pre-approves I'll submit the funding request. We9ll also create a short oncall playbook.

devops-rotations-bot: New oncall rota created: team-backend-Jun2026-rotations, link: https://rotations.internal/reports/team-backend-Jun2026

Alex Kim: For the handoff checklist — draft below, feel free to edit:
```
- Create runbook for top 10 incidents
- Share KV cache dump + access notes
- Tag high-risk PRs and assign owners
- Hand off pager runbook + escalation contacts
- Weekly async status note in #eng
```
Priya Nair: Adding two items: "verify CI credentials for contractor" and "set calendar auto-replies with overlap dates"

Michelle (People Ops): Timeline summary:
- By May 10: submit HR portal leave requests + physician note
- By May 12: Sam will verify payroll/visa impacts (Priya)
- By May 15: funding request submitted (Jordan)
- By May 20: contractor offer and setup
- June 1-7: shadow week & final handoff

Jordan Liu: I'll draft the funding request tonight and ping @Michelle when submitted. Also will post the oncall playbook to the rotations link.

Alex Kim: Thanks all. One more quick Q — can we stagger start times within the overlap (e.g., Alex does 4 days/week the first week) to reduce full-coverage days?

Michelle (People Ops): Staggering partial weeks is allowed. Use the leave request to indicate partial-week schedule (e.g., "Intermittent or reduced schedule: 4 days/week"), and make sure you and your manager document expectations for coverage. Payroll proration will apply for partial weeks.

Priya Nair: Perfect. I9ll update my request to indicate full weeks for my core 8 weeks; Alex, if you want partial the first week we9ll put that in notes.

Sam (People Ops): Follow-up: Priya, sent you a DM with the payroll checklist and a link to the contractor funding form.

Jordan Liu: Thanks @Sam @Michelle — I9ll keep everyone posted on approval. If we get pre-approval we can start interviewing contractors next week.

Alex Kim: Really appreciate the quick support. Feels good to have a plan. :heart:

Priya Nair: Thank you everyone!! :pray:
